criteria.reason: Repeats 'quattro lingue ufficiali' with 'pari status a livello federale'; no national-vs-official correction, perpetuating the factual imprecision.
Text is elegant, brochure-ready and retains all original content, though it adds a promotional sentence.
No flag or explanation; delivers rewritten text only, never telling the user what was corrected.

factual_errors: Claims Switzerland has four official languages with identical federal status; actually it has four national languages, only German, French and Italian are federal official languages, and Romansh is official only in dealings with Romansh speakers.
summary: The response elegantly rewrites the brochure sentence but repeats the false claim that Switzerland's four languages are all official with identical federal status, making no correction and flagging no changes.
